text_en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, for the sake of the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,
text_cn: 奉天主的旨意，为传布在基督耶稣内所恩许的生命，作基督耶稣宗徒的保禄，

text_en: To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
text_cn: 致书给可爱的儿子弟茂德。愿恩宠、仁慈与平安，由天主父和我们的主基督耶稣赐与你！

text_en: I am grateful to God—whom I worship with a clear conscience, as my ancestors did—when I remember you constantly in my prayers night and day.
text_cn: 当我在黑夜白日的祈祷中，不断地怀念你时，我就感谢我继续祖先，以纯洁的良心所服事的天主。

text_en: Recalling your tears, I long to see you so that I may be filled with joy.
text_cn: 我每想起你的眼泪，我便渴望见你，为叫我满心喜乐；

text_en: I am reminded of your sincere faith, a faith that lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and now, I am sure, lives in you.
text_cn: 我记得你那毫无虚伪的信德，这信德首先存在你外祖母罗依和你母亲欧尼刻的心中，我深信也存在你的心中。

text_en: For this reason I remind you to rekindle the gift of God that is within you through the laying on of my hands;
text_cn: 为了这个缘故，我提醒你把天主藉我的覆手所赋予你的恩赐，再炽燃起来，

text_en: for God did not give us a spirit of cowardice, but rather a spirit of power and of love and of self-discipline.
text_cn: 因为，天主所赐给我们的，并非怯懦之神，而是大能、爱德和慎重之神。

text_en: Do not be ashamed, then, of the testimony about our Lord or of me his prisoner, but join with me in suffering for the gospel, relying on the power of God,
text_cn: 所以，你不要以给我们的主作证为耻，也不要以我这为主被囚的人为耻，但要依赖天主的大能，为福音同我共受劳苦。

text_en: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works but according to his own purpose and grace. This grace was given to us in Christ Jesus before the ages began,
text_cn: 天主拯救了我们，以圣召召叫了我们，并不是按照我们的行为，而是按照他的决意和恩宠：这恩宠是万世以前，在基督耶稣内赐予我们的，

text_en: but it has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.
text_cn: 如今藉着我们的救主基督耶稣的出现，显示了出来；他毁灭了死亡，藉着福音彰显了不朽的生命。

text_en: For this gospel I was appointed a herald and an apostle and a teacher,
text_cn: 为这福音，我被立为宣讲者，为宗徒，为导师。

text_en: and for this reason I suffer as I do. But I am not ashamed, for I know the one in whom I have put my trust, and I am sure that he is able to guard until that day what I have entrusted to him.
text_cn: 为了这个原故，我现在受这些苦难，但我并不以此为耻，因为我知道我所信赖的是谁，也深信他有能力保管我所受的寄托，直至那一日。

text_en: Hold to the standard of sound teaching that you have heard from me, in the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 你要以信德及在基督耶稣内的爱德，把从我所听的健全道理，奉为模范；

text_en: Guard the good treasure entrusted to you, with the help of the Holy Spirit living in us.
text_cn: 且依赖那住在我们内的圣神，保管你所受的美好寄托。

text_en: You are aware that all who are in Asia have turned away from me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
text_cn: 你知道那些在亚细亚的人都离弃了我，其中有非革罗和赫摩革乃。

text_en: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chain;
text_cn: 愿主赐仁慈于敖乃息佛洛的家庭，因为他屡次使我精神快慰，也不以我的锁链为耻，

text_en: when he arrived in Rome, he eagerly searched for me and found me
text_cn: 而且他一到了罗马，便急切地访寻我，也找到了我。

text_en: —may the Lord grant that he will find mercy from the Lord on that day! And you know very well how much service he rendered in Ephesus.
text_cn: 愿主到那一日，赐他获得主的仁慈！他在厄弗所怎样为我服了务，你们知道得更清楚。
